theme_and_archetype.description: A premium digital identity recovery platform aiming for an Apple x Vercel x Linear aesthetic. Deep blacks, glowing neon accents, and hyper-smooth animations.

primary_heading.max_size: text-5xl lg:text-6xl (Do not exceed text-6xl for hero)

layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for large surfaces, rounded-full for buttons

global_rules.performance: Target 60 FPS using transform and opacity for transitions.
global_rules.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion using Tailwind motion-safe and motion-reduce classes.

effects.particles: react-tsparticles for subtle floating ambient dust in the background.
effects.aurora: CSS radial gradients using absolute positioning, low opacity (10-20%), and heavy blur (blur-3xl). Colors: #007AFF and #9333EA.
effects.mouse_spotlight: framer-motion to track mouse position and render a soft radial gradient on hoverable surfaces.
effects.cinematic_zoom: Hero section scales down from 1.05 to 1.0 over 2 seconds with ease-out on load.

PreHeroLoading.flow: Pitch black -> fade in logo -> particles emerge -> aurora glows -> tagline 'Protecting What You Built' types out -> cinematic zoom scales down to reveal Hero.

Hero.layout: Center-aligned content with generous negative space.
Hero.buttons: Premium CTAs: Primary is solid #FAFAFA text-black rounded-full hover:scale-105 transition-transform. Secondary is glassmorphism rounded-full.
Hero.reveal: framer-motion staggering (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0) for headline, subheadline, and CTAs.

RecoveryGalaxy.layout: 3 concentric orbit rings via CSS keyframes or framer-motion.
RecoveryGalaxy.elements: Profile avatars placed on rings revolving slowly.
RecoveryGalaxy.interactions: Hover pauses rotation -> profile glows -> tooltip appears with verified badge. Click zooms in -> review popup opens.

ReviewWall.layout: Infinite masonry grid (CSS columns or react-masonry-css) with 3-4 columns.
ReviewWall.animations: Columns translating vertically in alternating directions using react-fast-marquee or framer-motion.
ReviewWall.interactions: Clicking a review opens the GlassPopup.

GlassPopup.layout: Fullscreen fixed modal with heavy glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/60).
GlassPopup.navigation: Supports keyboard (Esc to close, Arrows to navigate) and swipe (framer-motion drag).
GlassPopup.content: Focuses on the user review, rating, and verified digital identity status.

abstract_backgrounds.description: Electric blue cinematic light lines for aurora background
Blue and white light illustration for section transitions

avatars.description: Professional female portrait for orbit ring
Professional male portrait for orbit ring

trust_icons.description: Abstract 3D glassmorphic shapes for trust section

accessibility_and_testing.aria_rules: Use aria-hidden='true' for purely decorative particles and aurora elements. Ensure all popups use role='dialog' and aria-modal='true'.
accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none rounded on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React (Create React App), JavaScript (.js NOT .tsx), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, framer-motion, lucide-react
critical_commands: yarn add framer-motion lucide-react react-tsparticles tsparticles react-fast-marquee
instructions_to_main_agent.implementation_notes: Prioritize performance for the animations. Do NOT use .tsx files. Use pure CSS or framer-motion for the orbit rings. Map media_urls directly into the respective avatar and background elements. Use glassmorphism heavily as specified in layout_and_spacing.
